report.disclaimer: This report assesses communication risk only. It makes no finding on facts, cause, product quality or legal liability, and passes no judgement on any organisation named. It rests on the material submitted and on public sources as of the run date, which may be incomplete; reviewer models can be wrong, and simulated reactions are labelled as such. It is not legal, regulatory, financial or other professional advice; laws are a starting list and every citation is fact-checked; an Escalate verdict means a lawyer must review. Third-party statements are quoted briefly for commentary, with attribution; their rights remain with their owners. This disclaimer makes no tactic acceptable: black means are assessed, never planned.
